routes.name: Tourist Visa
routes.summary: Needs an invitation letter from the State Migration Service, usually arranged through a travel agency. Apply at a Turkmen embassy. A new e-visa portal was reported but not confirmed on an official page.

other: Invitation letter from the State Migration Service
UK embassy: standard processing 10 business days
Visa-free and e-visa rules not confirmed

documents: Passport and copy of main page

routes.name: Transit Visa
routes.summary: Transit stays are limited to 5 days. Needs a letter stating dates and route plus visas for the next country.

other: Copies of entry and exit country visas
Fee at the UK embassy is USD 10 paid in GBP, other embassies may differ

routes.name: Work, business, investor, study and private visas
routes.summary: These visas all need an invitation letter from the State Migration Service, requested by the inviting company, organization or person in Turkmenistan. Durations and fees were not confirmed.

other: Invitation from the inviting party in Turkmenistan
